def select_next_node(graph, unvisited_nodes):
    pre = graph.graph.get('precomputed', {})
    max_core = pre.get('max_core_k', 1)
    bridge_ratio = pre.get('bridge_ratio_high_bc', 0.1)
    degree_variance = pre.get('degree_variance', 0)
    apl_lcc = pre.get('apl_lcc', 1)
    diameter_lcc = pre.get('diameter_lcc', 1)
    avg_degree = pre.get('avg_degree', 1)

    degs = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['degree'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    betw = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['betweenness'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    core = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['core_number'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    eig = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['eigenvector'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    cluster = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['clustering'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)

    def norm(x):
        rng = x.ptp()
        return (x - x.min()) / rng if rng > 1e-12 else np.zeros_like(x)

    deg_n = norm(degs)
    betw_n = norm(betw)
    core_n = norm(core)
    eig_n = norm(eig)
    inv_cluster_n = 1 - norm(cluster)

    neighbors_dict = {n: set(graph.neighbors(n)) & set(unvisited_nodes) for n in unvisited_nodes}
    neighbor_inv_clust_sum = np.array([
        sum(1 - graph.nodes[nei]['clustering'] for nei in neighbors_dict[n]) for n in unvisited_nodes
    ], dtype=float)
    neighbor_inv_clust_norm = norm(neighbor_inv_clust_sum)

    # Revised weights: emphasize core and betweenness, reduce eigenvector & degree
    w_betw = 0.40 * (1 + bridge_ratio / (bridge_ratio + 1))
    w_core = 0.35 * (1 + max_core / (max_core + 3))

    weights = np.array([w_betw, w_core, w_deg, w_eig, w_inv_clust])
    weights /= weights.sum()

    metric_matrix = np.vstack([
        betw_n,
        core_n,
        deg_n,
        eig_n,
        inv_cluster_n
    ]).T

    fused_scores = metric_matrix.dot(weights)

    diameter_lcc = pre.get('diameter_lcc', 1)
    avg_degree = pre.get('avg_degree', 1)

    # Extract raw metric arrays
    degs = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['degree'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    betw = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['betweenness'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    core = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['core_number'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    eig = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['eigenvector'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    cluster = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['clustering'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)

    def norm(x):
        rng = x.max() - x.min()
        return (x - x.min()) / rng if rng > 1e-12 else np.zeros_like(x)

    # Normalize metrics
    deg_n = norm(degs)
    betw_n = norm(betw)
    core_n = norm(core)
    eig_n = norm(eig)
    cluster_n = norm(cluster)
    inv_cluster_n = 1 - cluster_n

    # Compute local fragmentation impact per node (sum of 1 - clustering of neighbors)
    neighbors_dict = {n: set(graph.neighbors(n)) & set(unvisited_nodes) for n in unvisited_nodes}
    local_frag = np.array([
        sum(1 - graph.nodes[nei]['clustering'] for nei in neighbors_dict[n]) for n in unvisited_nodes
    ], dtype=float)
    local_frag_n = norm(local_frag) + 1e-9  # avoid div by zero in harmonic mean

    # Centrality fusion: weighted average emphasizing betweenness, core, and inverse clustering
    w_betw = 0.35 * (1 + bridge_ratio)
    w_core = 0.30 * (1 + max_core / (max_core + 1))
    w_inv_clust = 0.20 * (1 + diameter_lcc / (diameter_lcc + 3))
    w_deg = 0.10 * (1 + degree_variance)
    w_eig = 0.05 * (1 + apl_lcc / (apl_lcc + 2))

    weights = np.array([w_betw, w_core, w_inv_clust, w_deg, w_eig])
    weights /= weights.sum()

    # Construct centrality matrix
    centrality_matrix = np.vstack([
        betw_n + 1e-9,
        core_n + 1e-9,
        inv_cluster_n + 1e-9,
        deg_n + 1e-9,
        eig_n + 1e-9
    ]).T

    centrality_scores = centrality_matrix.dot(weights)

    # Dynamic alpha balances centrality vs local fragmentation based on degree variance and bridge_ratio
    alpha = np.clip(0.5 + 0.4 * bridge_ratio - 0.3 * (degree_variance / (avg_degree + 1e-9)), 0.3, 0.8)

    # Harmonic mean fusion to emphasize nodes strong in both centrality and fragmentation impact
    fused_scores = 2 / (alpha / centrality_scores + (1 - alpha) / local_frag_n)

    max_idx = np.argmax(fused_scores)
    next_node = unvisited_nodes[max_idx]

    return next_node

    degs = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['degree'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    betw = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['betweenness'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    core = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['core_number'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    eig = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['eigenvector'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)
    cluster = np.array([graph.nodes[n]['clustering'] for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)

    def norm(x):
        rng = x.max() - x.min()
        return (x - x.min()) / rng if rng > 1e-12 else np.zeros_like(x)

    deg_n = norm(degs)
    betw_n = norm(betw)
    core_n = norm(core)
    eig_n = norm(eig)
    cluster_n = norm(cluster)

    # Weights shifted: emphasize betweenness and core number,
    # penalize clustering, moderate eigenvector and degree
    w_betw = 0.35 * (1 + bridge_ratio)
    w_core = 0.30 * (1 + max_core / (max_core + 1))
    w_eig = 0.20 * (1 + 1 / (apl_lcc + 1))
    w_deg = 0.10 * (1 + degree_variance)
    w_cluster = 0.05 * (1 + np.log1p(apl_lcc))

    weights = np.array([w_betw, w_core, w_eig, w_deg, w_cluster])
    weights /= weights.sum()

    centrality_scores = (w_betw * betw_n +
                         w_core * core_n +
                         w_eig * eig_n +
                         w_deg * deg_n +
                         w_cluster * (1 - cluster_n))  # inverse clustering to prefer low clustering

    neighbors_dict = {n: set(graph.neighbors(n)) & set(unvisited_nodes) for n in unvisited_nodes}
    neighbor_inv_cluster_sum = np.array([sum(1 - graph.nodes[nei]['clustering'] for nei in neighbors_dict[n]) for n in unvisited_nodes], dtype=float)

    local_frag_impact = norm(neighbor_inv_cluster_sum)

    # Dynamic alpha: more centrality focus for low degree variance, more local fragmentation for high variance
    alpha = np.clip(0.7 - 0.6 * (degree_variance / (avg_degree + 1e-9)), 0.2, 0.7)

    final_scores = alpha * centrality_scores + (1 - alpha) * local_frag_impact

    max_idx = np.argmax(final_scores)
    next_node = unvisited_nodes[max_idx]

    return next_node
